Carla (support): FYI customer TKT-9876 reporting intermittent 504s from hosted inference over the last 45m. They see long tail latency spikes ~30s p95/p99 and a bunch of gateway 502/504. Link: https://support.redwood/tickets/9876 :warning:
IncidentBot: Pager routed to oncall: alice (oncall) at 2076543215
Alice (oncall): I'm on it. Carla, can you paste a sample request id or the gateway log snippet? That will help trace to a host/pool.
Carla (support): Sample req id: req_0a3f7c. Gateway logs (redacted): ```2026-03-14T21:12:03Z ERROR gateway request=req_0a3f7c upstream=hosted-gw-12 timeout after 15s; status=504``` Also customer says these spikes are correlated with long seq-length prompts (10k tokens) and bursty traffic.
Ben SRE: I'm seeing a spike in request_queue_depth on hosted-gw cluster around 21:10 UTC. Metrics: queue_depth max=620, p95 wait=4.2s, tail>18s. Config max_queue_depth per-host was 512, so we're hitting early-reject and fallback behavior.
Dave (runtime): Relevant runtime logs show continuous-batching backlog: batcher=continuous_batcher shard=3 backlog=480 processing_rate=~0.6 batch/sec. Large KV cache churn from very long contexts causing per-request token generation to stall batching. Example error from batcher: ```batch_wait_exceeded -> drop=0 early_reject=1```.
Alice (oncall): Can we temporarily lower contiguous-batch window or enable stricter early-reject to protect latency? Also we'll throttle that tenant if spike persists.
Ben SRE: Pushed a hotfix to gateway to change max_queue_depth=256 and set early_reject_threshold=0.85 at 21:20 UTC. Rolling restart of gw pods completed 21:24 UTC. Observed queue_depth drop to <200 within 3m. :thumbsup:
Carla (support): Customer confirms errors decreased immediately after 21:25 but still sees occasional p99 ~12s. They're on a bursty schedule and asked for a root cause and mitigation plan.
Dave (runtime): Root cause brief: a single tenant produced a small number of requests with huge context lengths (~8k-12k tokens) that prevented efficient batching. Continuous batcher groups based on compatible prompt shapes; these long prompts block the batch path and reduce batch fill for other tenants, producing head-of-line latency. The gateway queue filled while waiting for KV/cache priming.
Evan (CS): Which customer is this? Can we patch their app or recommend chunking? Also need recommended SLO language.
Carla (support): Customer: AcroMaps (acct: acrom-42). They declined immediate prompt changes. They requested we reduce errors and avoid changing their throughput.
Dave (runtime): Short-term mitigations:
- enforce tenant-level request concurrency limit (max_inflight_per_tenant=4)
- enable aggressive early-reject for single long requests
- add heuristic to route extremely long contexts to dedicated low-throughput workers (isolation)
I've opened ENG-4567 with patch suggestion and a small shepherded rollout.
Ben SRE: I've applied tenant concurrency limit override for acrom-42 at 21:34 UTC (applied via config service). Their sustained queue contribution dropped ~70%.
Alice (oncall): We should also add alerting: queue_depth > 400 for >2min -> page SRE and create temporary throttling runbook. I'll create PR for alert.
Carla (support): Customer wants repro steps for their engineers so they can self-detect. Dave, can you add a minimal repro?
Dave (runtime): Repro (share with devs):
1) craft a prompt of ~10k tokens (or multiple concatenated docs) + 2K token generation target
2) send 5 simultaneous requests from same tenant (curl example):
```bash
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do 
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate \ 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
    -d '{"model":"rwd-xxx","prompt":"<10k-token-payload>","max_tokens":2000}' &
done
wait
```
3) watch /metrics for continuous_batcher_backlog, request_queue_depth spike and p99 latency. Expected: backlog >> 200 and p99 > 10s within 30s.
Carla (support): I'll paste that in customer ticket and suggest chunking + lower concurrency as immediate mitigations.
Ben SRE: Postfix notes: We should add a scheduling heuristic to the batcher to avoid grouping long-context requests at the front of the queue (fairness). Filed SCHED-221.
Alice (oncall): Immediate status: mitigated (gateway hotfix + tenant concurrency). Ongoing: runtime changes + batcher heuristics + alerting. Next update in 2h or when we have a runtime patch. :eyes:
Carla (support): Customer accepted mitigations and wants a timeline for permanent fix. I'll coordinate with PM.
IncidentBot: Incident severity reduced to SEV-3 at 21:40 UTC — monitoring.
Dave (runtime): Action items:
- ENG-4567 runtime patch for isolation routing (owner: Dave)
- SCHED-221 batcher scheduling heuristic (owner: Ben)
- ALERT-910 add queue_depth paged alert (owner: Alice)
- CS-438 customer comms + timeline (owner: Carla)
I'll target a canary deploy of the runtime patch in 48-72h.
Carla (support): Thanks team — adding this thread to postmortem if we need one. Will update ticket TKT-9876 with timeline and the repro steps. :white_check_mark:
